notes: Fixed a bug where random unrelated words scraped off a company's website (city names, nationalities, or menu links like 'downloads'/'investors') could end up in the exported description text (e.g. 'Manufacturer of investors'). Note: if your results still look thin or wrong for a market, first double-check your DEEPSEEK_API_KEY in .env is a valid, working key - an invalid key silently degrades results for every run.
